title: chat-server: decide fail-open vs fail-closed default for may_set_* permission hooks
description: ChatBackend may_set_space_ban, may_set_space_invite, may_set_pinned_messages, may_set_custom_emoji (backend.rs) default to Ok(Ok(())): a backend that forgets to override enforces no spec permission. Fail-closed defaults would force opt-in but break every existing backend at once. Decision for Mark; record outcome here.
notes: Decision (Mark, 2026-10-19): fail open. may_set_* hook defaults stay Ok(Ok(())); production backends override. Already documented on each hook (backend.rs 'Default implementation' sections).
close_reason: Decided: fail open (Mark, 2026-10-19). No code change; existing defaults and docs match.
